text:
[NERR.15.2] After pump returns an error, engine state is whatever the pump
produced — there is **no rollback**. Subsequent pumps continue from there;
fixing the cause and pumping again resumes work. A halt is the exception: after
`DS_ERR_ENGINE_HALTED` nothing resumes, and the engine is only freed
([NCBK.2.9]).
